modes.description: Middle piece of a pinyin herbal formula name or a Chinese or Japanese personal name.
modes.example: y<<ao>> zhi mu tang) treats musculos

modes.description: The "YA" piece in the drug name VOYDEYA in label text.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of VOYDE<<YA>> is 150 mg three times

modes.description: Piece inside a place or school name.
modes.example: approximately 25 students from Bay<<ard>> Middle School in Wilmington
